app_documentation:
UniStudy is a comprehensive university study notes sharing platform designed to facilitate collaborative learning among university students. The platform serves as a centralized hub where students can upload, browse, download, and share study materials for various courses, while also enabling them to form and participate in study groups for enhanced peer-to-peer learning. Built with modern web technologies including React for the frontend and Node.js/Express for the backend, UniStudy provides a mobile-responsive experience that allows students to access educational resources anytime, anywhere.

The platform's core features include a robust note sharing system where students can upload PDF study materials tagged with course information, making them discoverable through an advanced search and filtering interface. Users can rate and review shared notes on a 1-5 star scale, ensuring quality content rises to the top and helping students identify the most valuable resources. The study group formation feature allows students to create subject-specific groups with optional member limits, join existing groups, and collaborate with peers on specific topics. A comprehensive notification system keeps users informed about new notes in their courses, group activities, and interactions with their content through real-time updates.

UniStudy is specifically designed for university students who need a reliable platform to share knowledge and collaborate on their studies. The application supports three user roles: Students (primary users who upload and download notes), Admins (who manage platform operations), and Moderators (who ensure content quality). With secure authentication requiring university email verification, AWS S3-based file storage for scalability, and a PostgreSQL database managing all user data, notes, groups, ratings, and notifications, UniStudy provides a secure and efficient environment for academic collaboration.

The platform prioritizes user experience with a clean, card-based interface using a purple primary color scheme that conveys trust and creativity. Features like bookmarking notes, following other users, tracking download statistics, and receiving personalized notifications create an engaging ecosystem that encourages knowledge sharing. Whether students are preparing for exams, looking for comprehensive course materials, or seeking study partners, UniStudy provides the tools and community to support their academic success.

glossary.Note Sharing: The core feature allowing students to upload study materials (primarily PDFs) with metadata including title, description, course tags, and file information. Notes are stored in AWS S3 and can be searched, filtered, downloaded, and rated by other students on the platform.
glossary.Study Group: A collaborative learning community created by students around specific subjects or courses. Groups have an admin (creator), optional maximum member limits, and enable students to join, participate in discussions, and receive notifications about group activities.
glossary.Rating System: A quality assurance mechanism where students can rate downloaded notes on a 1-5 star scale and optionally provide written reviews. The system calculates and displays average ratings to help users identify high-quality content, with each user limited to one rating per note.
glossary.University Email Verification: A security and authentication requirement where users must register using their official university email address and verify it before gaining full access to the platform. This ensures the community consists of legitimate university students and maintains platform integrity.
glossary.Notification System: A real-time communication feature using WebSockets that alerts users about relevant activities including new notes uploaded in their followed courses, messages in their study groups, ratings on their uploaded content, and other platform interactions. Notifications can be filtered by read/unread status.
glossary.JWT Authentication: JSON Web Token-based secure authentication system that manages user sessions, login/logout functionality, and protects API endpoints. Users receive a token upon successful login that must be included in subsequent requests to access protected resources and features.
